question: True or false: a <title> rendered inside an <svg> is also moved into the document <head>.
say: True or false: a title rendered inside an S V G is also moved into the document head.
explanation: False. Inside an <svg>, <title> stays where it is and labels the graphic for accessibility. Only document titles are moved to <head>.
explainSay: False. Inside an S V G, the title stays where it is and describes the graphic.
